'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Ben Brummett DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ben Brummett]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Destroyers 4.1'''. Shields 6–12 blank on sheet (5 shields only). Line 28–29 '''Master Destroyers''' best-effort from handwriting; line 40 '''Masterful Move & Undercover''' as written; line 11–12 Japanese-language '''Oh, Switch Off'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Invasion / Incomplete Control]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
